name: universal-prompt-optimizer
description: Adaptive, model-aware prompt optimization for coding agents. Preserves user intent and constraints, with no extra LLM calls.

scripts.test:evals:mock: python -B -m evals.provider --cases evals/cases.jsonl --mode MATRIX --approve --output evals/results/matrix.json --provider python tests/provider_mock.py && python -B -m evals.validate_report evals/results/matrix.json --kind matrix
scripts.test:evals:regression: npm run test:evals:mock && npm run test:evals:baseline
scripts.update:evals:baseline: npm run test:evals:mock && python -B -m evals.update_baseline --candidate evals/results/matrix.json --output evals/baselines/matrix.json
scripts.test: python -B -m unittest discover -s tests -v && npm run test:evals:strict && npm run test:runtime
